description: Reading themes and flexible page padding for VS Code Markdown previews, with sidebar controls.
config.title: Yuejing Markdown
config.fontSize: Markdown preview body font size in pixels (10–32). Headings and code scale with it.
config.tableRowHeight: Minimum table row height in pixels (24–120). Wide tables scroll horizontally; line breaks and taller content can increase the height.
config.horizontalMargin: Left and right preview page padding in pixels (0–320; decimals allowed). Select Custom padding mode to apply it, including a true 0px. Narrow previews cap custom side padding to preserve readable space. Does not change print margins.
config.verticalMargin: Top and bottom preview page padding in pixels (0–320; decimals allowed). Select Custom padding mode to apply it, including a true 0px. Does not change print margins.
config.horizontalMarginMode: Use the theme's horizontal padding, or apply the custom pixel value. Existing 0.3.1 settings keep their old meaning until a mode is selected.
config.verticalMarginMode: Use the theme's vertical padding, or apply the custom pixel value. Existing 0.3.1 settings keep their old meaning until a mode is selected.
theme.vue.description: Vue documentation theme; follows the editor appearance.
theme.bamboo.description: Pale green reading page with Songti typography.
theme.clean.description: Clean gray reading page with sans serif typography.
theme.night.description: Fixed dark palette for night reading.
config.theme: Markdown reading theme. Novel themes use their own palettes; explicit high-contrast editor themes retain accessible editor colors.
